Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance

Class FetkovichAquifer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance.FetkovichAquifer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FetkovichAquifer extends Object implements Serializable
Finite, constant-property aquifer with reversible reservoir-volume water exchange.

Uses the rate and material-balance equations of Fetkovich (1971), SPE 2603-PA: dWe/dt = J * (pa - pr) and pa = pi - We / (ct * Wi). Positive influx is water leaving the aquifer and entering the reservoir. Volumes are reservoir m3 on one fixed water-volume basis, pressures are absolute bar, time is seconds and total aquifer compressibility is 1/bar. No surface-volume or formation-volume-factor conversion is performed.

Each interval integrates the linear rate law exactly for a linearly varying, prescribed reservoir pressure. This removes timestep error for that prescribed path, not error from an unknown nonlinear reservoir-pressure trajectory. A coupled reservoir calculation must solve its own pressure/volume closure and check interval refinement. Water exchange may reverse during repressurization; cumulative influx is not clipped to zero. The caller must account for both signs consistently and verify the slightly-compressible, constant-property approximation.

Zero productivity gives no exchange. Zero storage gives the zero-influx limit, with instantaneous pressure equilibration for positive productivity. Explicitly infinite initial water volume and positive compressibility represent constant-pressure support. These limits do not model radial transient diffusion; use VanEverdingenHurstAquifer for that distinct approximation.

      public FetkovichAquifer(double initialWaterVolumeM3, double totalCompressibilityPerBar, double productivityM3PerSecondPerBar, double initialPressureBara)

      Parameters:
      initialWaterVolumeM3 - nonnegative aquifer water volume in reservoir m3; positive infinity selects infinite storage when compressibility is positive
      totalCompressibilityPerBar - finite nonnegative total water/rock compressibility in 1/bar
      productivityM3PerSecondPerBar - finite nonnegative aquifer productivity in reservoir m3/(s bar)
      initialPressureBara - finite positive initial aquifer pressure in bara

    • advance

      public FetkovichAquifer.State advance(FetkovichAquifer.State state, double durationSeconds, double reservoirPressureStartBara, double reservoirPressureEndBara)
      Advances an immutable state for a prescribed linear reservoir-pressure interval.

      Evaluates the exact constant-capacitance ODE using exponential functions with stable small-step series. Rejected intervals leave the input state unchanged. A state restored by serialization or produced by an identically parameterized model may be resumed; incompatible model states are rejected.

      Parameters:
      state - previous aquifer state from this parameter set
      durationSeconds - finite positive interval duration in seconds
      reservoirPressureStartBara - finite positive reservoir pressure at interval start, bara
      reservoirPressureEndBara - finite positive reservoir pressure at interval end, bara
      Returns:
      accepted new immutable aquifer state
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the interval exhausts finite water inventory or produces non-finite evidence
